title: Do / Does / Did 強調句
titleEn: Using emphatic do, does and did in affirmative clauses

source.file: Sentence Structure 167 -「Do _ Does _ Did 強調句」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Subject + do + base verb + other information

formulas.labelZh: 現在式 I / you / we / they
formulas.formula: Subject + do + base verb + other information
Subject + does + base verb + other information
Subject + did + base verb + other information

rules.zh: 使用 do、does 或 did 後，主要動詞必須使用原形，不能再加 -s 或使用過去式。
rules.en: The main verb must remain in the base form When do, does or did is used, the main verb must not carry an -s or past-tense ending. She does like the song. Tom did say that. She does likes the song. Tom did said that.

rules.zh: do：I、you、we、they 的現在式 does：he、she、it 或單數主語的現在式 did：所有主語的過去式
rules.en: Choose do, does or did according to the subject and tense do：I、you、we、they does：he、she、it did： We do need more time. He does need more time. They did need more time.

rules.zh: 本課的目標句型是在肯定句中加入強調語氣。 （她關心團隊。） （她的確關心團隊。）
rules.en: This lesson focuses on affirmative emphasis The target structure is used in an affirmative statement to add emphasis. Neutral: She cares about the team. Emphatic: She does care about the team.
examples: The target structure is used in an affirmative statement to add emphasis.
She does care about the team.

rules.zh: 不要把 do、does 或 did 放在情態動詞之前；如情態動詞出現在另一個子句，仍可在主要動詞前使用強調 do。
rules.en: Do not place do before a modal verb Do not use do, does or did directly before verbs such as: can could will would should may might must She does can help us. She really can help us. However, do can be used before another main verb when a modal appears later in a different clause: I do believe she can help us.
examples: I do believe she can help us.

rules.zh: 標準現代英語通常不在 be 前使用強調 do；應直接強調 am、is、are、was 或 were。
rules.en: Do not normally use emphatic do before be In standard modern English, we do not normally say: I do be tired. She does be kind. They did be late. Instead, emphasise be directly: I really am tired. She really is kind. They really were late.

rules.zh: 說話時，do、does 和 did 通常需要重讀。 這種重讀能讓聽者清楚留意說話者正在糾正、保證或強調某件事。
rules.en: Do is usually stressed when speaking In speech, do, does and did normally receive strong pronunciation. I DO understand. She DOES care. He DID call. This spoken stress helps listeners notice the correction, reassurance or emphasis.
examples: In speech, do, does and did normally receive strong pronunciation.

benefits.zh: 當別人有所誤解時，你可以用這個句型清楚作出糾正。 （我的確聯絡過她。） did 能突出這個行動確實發生過。
benefits.en: It helps you correct a misunderstanding You can use this structure when someone believes something that is not true. Someone may think: You did not contact her. You can reply: I did contact her. The word did draws attention to the fact that the action really happened. did
examples: You can use this structure when someone believes something that is not true.
The word did draws attention to the fact that the action really happened.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能表明你的意見、感受或承諾是真誠的。 與完全中性的陳述相比，這些句子通常顯得更真誠、更有人情味。
benefits.en: It helps you sound sincere This structure can show that your opinion, feeling or promise is genuine. I do appreciate your help. I do hope you feel better soon. We do care about our customers. These sentences may sound warmer and more sincere than completely neutral statements.
examples: I do hope you feel better soon.
We do care about our customers.
These sentences may sound warmer and more sincere than completely neutral statements.

benefits.zh: 提到困難、懷疑或相反觀點後，你可以使用強調助動詞突出真正的重要訊息。 （她可能很安靜，但她的確喜歡小組討論。） 這個句型能令前後的對比更加明顯。
benefits.en: It creates a clear contrast You can use emphatic do after mentioning a difficulty, doubt or opposing idea. She may be quiet, but she does enjoy group discussions. The structure makes the contrast easier to notice.
examples: You can use emphatic do after mentioning a difficulty, doubt or opposing idea.
She may be quiet, but she does enjoy group discussions.
The structure makes the contrast easier to notice.

benefits.zh: 學生經常重複使用 really、certainly 和 definitely。 這讓你可以用另一種自然方法加強語氣，避免表達方式過於重複。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to really and definitely Learners often repeat words such as really, certainly and definitely. Instead of always saying: I really agree with you. You can say: I do agree with you. This gives you another natural way to emphasise your meaning.

benefits.zh: 當別人擔心或不確定你的感受及意圖時，這個句型可以幫助你作出肯定。 加入強調後，安慰和保證的語氣會更加清楚。
benefits.en: It helps you reassure another person The structure is useful when someone is worried or unsure about your feelings or intentions. I do believe you. We do want you to stay. She does understand your situation. The emphasis makes the reassurance clearer.
examples: The structure is useful when someone is worried or unsure about your feelings or intentions.
We do want you to stay.
The emphasis makes the reassurance clearer.

benefits.zh: 在命令句中，do 可以令請求帶有鼓勵、禮貌或溫和但堅定的語氣。 當你真心希望對方接受邀請、記住提醒或採取行動時，這個句型十分實用。
benefits.en: It can make a request warmer but more insistent In an imperative, do can make a request sound encouraging, polite or gently insistent. Do sit down. Do let me know. Do take care. This form is useful when you genuinely want someone to follow the request.
examples: In an imperative, do can make a request sound encouraging, polite or gently insistent.
